ruleDefinitions.name: File With Suspicious Extension Downloaded Via Bitsadmin
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of bitsadmin downloading a file with a suspicious extension

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\bitsadmin\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "bitsadmin\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/transfer\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/create\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/addfile\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.7z.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.asax.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.ashx.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.asmx.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.asp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.aspx.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.bat.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.cfm.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.cgi.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.chm.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.cmd.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dll.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.gif.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.jpeg.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.jpg.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.jsp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.jspx.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.log.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.png.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.ps1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.psm1.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.rar.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.scf.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.sct.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.txt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.vbe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.vbs.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.war.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.wsf.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.wsh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.xll.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.zip.*")))
